import copy, importlib.util, json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
UTC=timezone.utc; NOW=datetime(2026,10,28,12,tzinfo=UTC)
passed=[]

def inputs(now=NOW):
 c={'window_id':'bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000001','account':'877573132739','region':'us-east-1','hostname':'beta.getforma.dev','operator':'Independent synthetic reviewer','ingress_mode':'public','operator_ipv4_cidr':'1.1.1.1/32','deployment_expires_at_utc':(now+timedelta(hours=48)).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),'tls_certificate_arn':'arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:877573132739:certificate/bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000001','image_digest':'877573132739.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/independent@sha256:'+'a'*64,'image_architecture':'ARM64','service_desired_count':1,'extra_task_hours':2}
 l={'schema_version':1,'scope':'genui-beta-incremental','months':{},'windows':{}}
 month=now.replace(day=1,hour=0,minute=0,second=0,microsecond=0)
 until=now+timedelta(hours=49)
 while month < until:
  l['months'][month.strftime('%Y-%m')]={'reconciled_at_utc':now.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),'basis':'Independent synthetic fixture only','prior_extra_spend_cents':0,'variable_reserve_cents':1000,'auth_spent_or_reserved_cents':500,'unallocated_cents':2500}
  month=month.replace(year=month.year+1,month=1) if month.month==12 else month.replace(month=month.month+1)
 return c,l

def fixture():
 c,l=inputs(); _,r=m.reserve(c,l,NOW)
 cluster='arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:877573132739:cluster/independent'
 service=cluster.replace(':cluster/',':service/')+'/app'
 role='arn:aws:iam::877573132739:role/independent'
 arn='arn:aws:scheduler:us-east-1:877573132739:schedule/independent/expiry'
 outputs={'ClusterName':'independent','ServiceName':'app','TaskDefinition':'arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:877573132739:task-definition/independent:1','DeploymentExpiryScheduleArn':arn,'DeploymentExpiryGroup':'independent','DeploymentExpiryRoleArn':role}
 stack={'StackStatus':'CREATE_COMPLETE','Parameters':[{'ParameterKey':k,'ParameterValue':str(v)} for k,v in r['cloudformation_parameters'].items()],'Outputs':[{'OutputKey':k,'OutputValue':v} for k,v in outputs.items()]}
 sch={'Arn':arn,'State':'ENABLED','ScheduleExpressionTimezone':'UTC','ScheduleExpression':'at('+c['deployment_expires_at_utc'][:-1]+')','FlexibleTimeWindow':{'Mode':'OFF'},'Target':{'Arn':'arn:aws:scheduler:::aws-sdk:ecs:updateService','RoleArn':role,'Input':json.dumps({'Cluster':cluster,'Service':service,'DesiredCount':0}),'RetryPolicy':{'MaximumEventAgeInSeconds':900,'MaximumRetryAttempts':3}}}
 state={'account':c['account'],'stack':stack,'schedule':sch,'service':{'clusterArn':cluster,'serviceArn':service,'taskDefinition':outputs['TaskDefinition'],'status':'ACTIVE','desiredCount':0},'failures':[],'calls':[],'times':[NOW,NOW]}
 def call(*args):
  state['calls'].append(args)
  if args[:2]==('sts','get-caller-identity'): return {'Account':state['account']}
  if args[:2]==('cloudformation','describe-stacks'): return {'Stacks':[state['stack']]}
  if args[:2]==('scheduler','get-schedule'): return state['schedule']
  if args[:2]==('ecs','describe-services'): return {'services':[copy.deepcopy(state['service'])],'failures':state['failures']}
  if args[:2]==('ecs','update-service'):
   state['service']['desiredCount']=int(args[-1]);return {'service':copy.deepcopy(state['service'])}
  raise AssertionError(args)
 def clock(): return state['times'].pop(0)
 return c,r,state,call,clock

def mutate_payload(s,k,v):
 p=json.loads(s['schedule']['Target']['Input']);p[k]=v;s['schedule']['Target']['Input']=json.dumps(p)

mutations={
 'wrong_account':lambda s:s.update(account='000000000000'),
 'incomplete_stack':lambda s:s['stack'].update(StackStatus='UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS'),
 'parameter_drift':lambda s:s['stack']['Parameters'][0].update(ParameterValue='changed'),
 'schedule_wrong_account':lambda s:s['stack']['Outputs'][3].update(OutputValue='arn:aws:scheduler:us-east-1:000000000000:schedule/independent/expiry'),
 'disabled_schedule':lambda s:s['schedule'].update(State='DISABLED'),
 'wrong_schedule_timezone':lambda s:s['schedule'].update(ScheduleExpressionTimezone='America/New_York'),
 'wrong_schedule_expiry':lambda s:s['schedule'].update(ScheduleExpression='at(2026-10-30T12:00:01)'),
 'flexible_window':lambda s:s['schedule'].update(FlexibleTimeWindow={'Mode':'FLEXIBLE','MaximumWindowInMinutes':10}),
 'wrong_action':lambda s:s['schedule']['Target'].update(Arn='arn:aws:scheduler:::aws-sdk:ecs:runTask'),
 'wrong_role':lambda s:s['schedule']['Target'].update(RoleArn='arn:aws:iam::877573132739:role/other'),
 'wrong_retry':lambda s:s['schedule']['Target'].update(RetryPolicy={'MaximumEventAgeInSeconds':900,'MaximumRetryAttempts':4}),

 'wrong_service':lambda s:mutate_payload(s,'Service','arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:877573132739:service/independent/other'),
 'bool_zero':lambda s:mutate_payload(s,'DesiredCount',False),
 'float_zero':lambda s:mutate_payload(s,'DesiredCount',0.0),
 'string_zero':lambda s:mutate_payload(s,'DesiredCount','0'),
 'missing_zero':lambda s:mutate_payload(s,'DesiredCount',None),
 'unexpected_payload_field':lambda s:mutate_payload(s,'ForceNewDeployment',True),
 'duplicate_input_field':lambda s:s['schedule']['Target'].update(Input=s['schedule']['Target']['Input'][:-1]+',"DesiredCount":0}'),
 'live_wrong_task':lambda s:s['service'].update(taskDefinition=s['service']['taskDefinition']+'9'),
 'live_wrong_cluster':lambda s:s['service'].update(clusterArn='arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:877573132739:cluster/other'),
 'live_wrong_service':lambda s:s['service'].update(serviceArn='arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:877573132739:service/independent/other'),
 'service_failure':lambda s:s.update(failures=[{'reason':'MISSING'}]),
 'deployment_finished_too_late':lambda s:s.update(times=[NOW+timedelta(hours=48)-timedelta(minutes=9)]),
 'deployment_finished_after_expiry':lambda s:s.update(times=[NOW+timedelta(hours=49)]),
}
for name,change in mutations.items():
 c,r,s,call,clock=fixture();change(s)
 try: m.activate(c,r,call,clock)
 except (ValueError,KeyError): pass
 else: raise AssertionError(name+' incorrectly accepted')
 assert not any(a[:2]==('ecs','update-service') for a in s['calls']),name+' mutated compute'
 passed.append(name)

c,r,s,call,clock=fixture()
assert m.activate(c,r,call,clock)['status']=='activation_requested_not_healthy'
assert [a[-1] for a in s['calls'] if a[:2]==('ecs','update-service')]==['1']
passed.append('valid_live_activation')

c,r,s,call,clock=fixture();s['times']=[NOW,NOW+timedelta(hours=49)]
try: m.activate(c,r,call,clock)
except ValueError as e: assert 'stop requested' in str(e)
else: raise AssertionError('late response accepted')
assert [a[-1] for a in s['calls'] if a[:2]==('ecs','update-service')]==['1','0']
passed.append('late_response_compensating_stop')

def refuse(name,c,l,now=NOW):
 try:m.reserve(c,l,now)
 except ValueError:passed.append(name)
 else:raise AssertionError(name+' incorrectly accepted')

c,l=inputs();u,r=m.reserve(c,l,NOW)
assert r['cost_by_month']['2026-10']['genui_total_cents']==6849
assert r['cost_by_month']['2026-10']['project_total_cents']==9849
assert r['cloudformation_parameters']['ServiceDesiredCount']=='0'
passed.append('31_day_full_baseline_and_48_hour_allowance')
c.update(ingress_mode='operator',service_desired_count=0)
u2,r2=m.reserve(c,u,NOW+timedelta(minutes=1));assert u2==u and r2['reused_reservation']
passed.append('public_operator_transition_reuses_immutable_window')

bad=copy.deepcopy(c);bad['image_digest']=bad['image_digest'].replace('a'*64,'b'*64)
refuse('same_window_changed_image',bad,u)
bad=copy.deepcopy(c);bad['deployment_expires_at_utc']='2026-10-30T11:59:59Z'
refuse('same_window_changed_expiry',bad,u)
bad=copy.deepcopy(c);bad['window_id']='bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'
refuse('new_window_cannot_erase_prior_reservation',bad,u)

for name,delta in [('expiry_below_ten_minutes',timedelta(minutes=10,seconds=-1)),('expiry_above_48_hours',timedelta(hours=48,seconds=1))]:
 c,l=inputs();c['deployment_expires_at_utc']=(NOW+delta).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ');refuse(name,c,l)
c,l=inputs();c['deployment_expires_at_utc']=(NOW+timedelta(minutes=10)).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ');m.reserve(c,l,NOW);passed.append('expiry_exact_lower_bound')
for name,field,value in [('stale_ledger','reconciled_at_utc','2026-10-27T11:59:59Z'),('negative_spend','prior_extra_spend_cents',-1),('boolean_spend','prior_extra_spend_cents',False),('missing_variable_allowance','variable_reserve_cents',999),('missing_auth_allowance','auth_spent_or_reserved_cents',499),('missing_unallocated','unallocated_cents',2499),('known_extra_exceeds_budget','prior_extra_spend_cents',152)]:
 c,l=inputs();l['months']['2026-10'][field]=value;refuse(name,c,l)
roll=datetime(2026,12,31,12,tzinfo=UTC);c,l=inputs(roll)
_,r=m.reserve(c,l,roll)
assert set(r['cost_by_month'])=={'2026-12','2027-01'}
assert r['cost_by_month']['2027-01']['all_window_compute_reservations_cents']==474
assert r['cost_by_month']['2027-01']['retained_core_full_month_cents']==5229
passed.append('new_year_split_full_baseline_and_extra_allowance')
bad=copy.deepcopy(l);bad['months']['2027-01']['prior_extra_spend_cents']=320;refuse('next_month_overbudget',c,bad,roll)
bad=copy.deepcopy(l);del bad['months']['2027-01'];refuse('next_month_missing_reconciliation',c,bad,roll)
print(json.dumps({'status':'pass','checks':passed,'count':len(passed),'aws_calls':'controlled in-memory fakes only'},indent=2))

resolved_findings.finding: A slow stack deployment could miss a one-time expiry if count one were deployed directly.
resolved_findings.resolution: Template permits only initial count zero. Explicit activation rechecks completed stack, target/service identity and real future deadline immediately before count one. Late-response path requests a compensating stop. Delayed/expired activation negatives pass.

resolved_findings.finding: Extra standalone/deployment task hours reserved only in the first month would understate a window crossing month/year end.
resolved_findings.resolution: Full extra-task allowance is reserved in every touched month. A January near-limit fixture rejects; missing next-month reconciliation rejects.

resolved_findings.finding: Python dict equality accepted JSON false (and numeric 0.0) as DesiredCount zero, admitting a malformed stop target before activating service compute.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact integer zero is required; false, float, string and null independently reject before any update-service call. Producer adds exact live/response count checks.

resolved_findings.finding: Count-zero template wording incorrectly implied unrelated CloudFormation updates necessarily stop a drifted count-one service.
resolved_findings.resolution: Source description and runbook distinguish initial desired count from drift. Explicit request plus observed desired/running/pending zero and STOPPED task evidence is required before image/window/sole-stop replacement.

observations: Public/operator switching affects only ALB TCP 443. No new direct task/database ingress, HTTP listener, NAT, ECS Exec or public database is introduced.
Fargate app and migration retain 2 vCPU / 8 GiB; managed RDS/S3/KMS and exact existing logical-role boundaries remain.

Scheduler uses one UTC at() target, exact service ARN plus ecs:cluster condition, and scheduler.amazonaws.com trust restricted to the exact account and dedicated schedule group. It does not constrain desiredCount at the IAM layer; numeric zero comes from reviewed target data.

Budget arithmetic reserves a full calendar month of retained core, active window plus stop margin and extra tasks, retained earlier windows, actual extra spending and at least $10 variable allowance; GenUI <= $70, auth >= $5, fixed $25 unallocated, combined <= $100.

Private ledger reserves before activation under an exclusive persistent lock and atomic durable replacement; retries reuse immutable reservations. It refuses missing ledgers, stale reconciliation and known overruns. Its contents remain operator-reconciled assertions, not independently verified AWS billing.

31-day maximum 48-hour fixture: $52.29 retained core + $6.20 compute + $10 variable = $68.49 GenUI; $98.49 including $5 auth and $25 unallocated. This leaves little repeat-window headroom; choose a shorter first window and retain all unknown reservations.
required_live_gates: Verify actual account/deployment identity, exact registry digest/architecture, issued hostname certificate, service quotas and current resource prices before provisioning.
Observe managed migration exit, actual SQL grants and forbidden-role operations, paired tenant S3/KMS denials, credential refresh/expiry, readiness and verified TLS.

Exercise a short real Scheduler stop and retain invocation evidence, desiredCount zero, service running/pending zero and observed tasks STOPPED. Creation/synthesis cannot prove universal target behavior, IAM propagation or delivery.

Observe service/tasks stopped before changing image/window/sole expiry schedule; unrelated CloudFormation updates may preserve count drift. Inspect and stop every standalone migration/test task separately.

Restore public HTTPS after the temporary operator /32 trial. Public transport does not establish invite-first signup, tenant membership, app entitlements or refusal of costly unauthorized work; owning application tickets remain open.

Reconcile actual costs and retained resources at expiry and month end, execute scoped cleanup/retention, and coordinate the separate $5 auth rehearsal within the total. No model spending in this slice.
limits: Review author called no AWS API and created no cloud resource; all activation API evidence is controlled local fixture behavior.
Scheduler is an operational backstop, not guaranteed timely delivery or an AWS billing cutoff. It does not stop standalone tasks or remove billable RDS/ALB/IPv4/storage/keys.
Preflight and runbook define the supported source path; they do not prevent an authorized AWS operator from bypassing them or changing deployed policies/schedules.
This verdict permits source landing and progression to separately operated managed qualification; it does not pass APP-007, PH01 or external-beta launch acceptance.
